A warm, soulfire-simmered broth ladled straight from the Soul Cauldron.

§6The Iron Stomach Effect§r
Drinking Soul Stew grants §6Iron Stomach§r for §e30 minutes§r:
• Hunger and saturation are locked at maximum (20.0).
• Food points never drain from sprinting, swimming, or natural healing.
• The HUD food bar is hidden while active, and the stew can be consumed even when full.
